summary: Backend-only testing for the new admin Settings addon (GET/PUT /api/settings, POST /api/auth/change-password, and full /api/users CRUD). Added /app/backend/tests/test_settings_users.py (19 new tests) and re-ran the existing regression suite (20 tests). All 39 tests passed. Visitor + attendance xlsx/pdf exports verified separately (200 OK with correct content-types). admin/admin123 and guard/guard123 credentials confirmed working at end of run (password-change test reverts itself). No bugs found.

minor.issue: passlib bcrypt version-detection warning: `module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'`. Cosmetic only - hashing/verification works fine. Could be silenced by pinning passlib>=1.7.5 with bcrypt<4 or by upgrading passlib. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~920 lines - approaching the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting into routers/ (auth.py, users.py, settings.py, visitors.py, labours.py, attendance.py, reports.py) for maintainability.
Unused module-level `api = FastAPI()` at line 46 - dead code, safe to remove.
PUT /api/settings strips whitespace and drops empty entries from list updates but does not deduplicate (e.g. ['Welder','Welder'] is stored as-is). Minor; consider de-duping while preserving order.
PUT /api/settings with `business_name=''` (whitespace only) silently no-ops. May want explicit 400 to give the admin clear feedback.
POST /api/auth/change-password validates `len(new_password) < 6` AFTER verifying current password. Order is fine, but consider also rejecting `new_password == current_password`.
create_user trims `name` but UserUpdate also trims when name passed - good. However an empty `name` (only spaces) update would set name='' silently. Consider rejecting empty after strip.

Settings GET is exposed to any authenticated user (including guard). This is by design per the spec, but business_name is the only field a guard arguably needs for branding - exposing labour_categories/visit_purposes/gates to guards is fine since those drive the entry forms they use.
JWT tokens have 12-hour expiry but there's no refresh endpoint - acceptable for an on-prem gate-mgmt app; document it.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. All TEST_-prefixed users / settings / visitors created during tests are cleaned up or reverted within the test bodies (delete_other_user_ok deletes the created guard; settings put-tests restore originals in try/finally; change-password test reverts to admin123 in finally). admin/admin123 and guard/guard123 verified still working after the suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now exist: test_backend_api.py (auth/visitors/contractors/labours/attendance/dashboard - 20 tests) and test_settings_users.py (settings/change-password/users - 19 tests). Both use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Run: `pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_N.xml`. Password-change test reverts admin to admin123 in a finally block - if a future test breaks mid-run, manually reset by re-seeding (delete admin user from db.users to trigger startup seed).
rca_of_issue: No bugs surfaced. The new endpoints behave per spec: role-based authz enforced (guard→403 on PUT settings, list/create/update/delete users), validation correct (password<6→400, invalid role→400, duplicate username→400, wrong current password→400, self-delete→400), settings doc auto-creates with sensible defaults on first GET, partial PUT only mutates supplied fields, and changes persist across requests.
